dedupe_keys.name: open access data for imaging and modeling crater floor subsidence at nyiragongo volcano drc

description: Open Access Data for Imaging and modeling crater floor subsidence at Nyiragongo Volcano, DRC is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by scholarsphere. Localized crater deformation can shed insight into shallow magma processes and eruption hazards. To study localized crater deformation at Nyiragongo volcano (Democratic Republic of Congo), we processed Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) time series using RADARSAT-2 ultra-fine satellite data spanning 2012-2019. Coverage: Democratic Republic of the Congo. The portal files it under the publisher scholarsphere. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
